definitions: Used to add something to what you have just been saying, especially something that you think is more important.
Used to return to an earlier subject after a digression.
Used to indicate that something happened or is true despite something else that might have prevented it.
Used to indicate that something is true or will happen regardless of other factors or circumstances.
examples: I don't really like it, but thanks anyway.
Anyway, as I was saying, we need to leave soon.
It was raining, but we went out anyway.
I'll do it anyway, even if you don't help.
